skill_outcomes.outcome_description: State basic concepts about system of linear equations.
Explain basic concepts about matrices and determinants; list properties of matrix operations and determinant properties.
Elaborate on basic concepts about vectors and vector spaces.
Describe the concept of linear transformation and summarize its properties; explain diagonalization method of matrices.
Solve system of linear equations using various methods such as Gaussian elimination, Gauss-Jordan elimination, matrix method, determinant method.
Solve problems related to matrices such as finding matrix sum, product, rank, inverse, and determinant.
Solve problems related to vector space such as proving a set is a subspace, finding basis and dimension of a vector space, determining linear independence or dependence of a set of vectors.
Identify linear transformations and solve problems related to finding matrix representation, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and diagonalization of matrices.
Explain basic economic concepts such as supply function, demand function, market equilibrium.

Apply knowledge and skills about systems of equations, matrices, and determinants to establish and solve models of single commodity market equilibrium, multiple commodity markets, macroeconomic equilibrium model, input-output balance model, network analysis, text encoding, Markov chains.
Develop personal responsibility and group responsibility.
Develop ability to learn independently, research independently, work independently, and work in teams.
